recent_headlines.title: PIMCO's Ivascyn says market has not yet seen the peak in US Treasury yields; expects Fed to hold in October, with one or two more rate hikes this cycle
Fed's Barkin (2027 voter) says 2% inflation is not some unicorn, is something we can hit
New Zealand Dollar recovers on weaker US Dollar, softer Oil ahead key US CPI
Canadian Dollar recovers as softer US Dollar offers relief ahead of US CPI
US Treasury sells 6-wk bills at high-rate 3.980%, B/C 2.58x
Stocks of crude oil in the US SPR were unchanged at 283mln bbls last week, lowest level since October 1982
